war_summary: War 139 is on day 122 with no winner and 32 towns required for victory. Strategic-base ownership is currently dominated by the Colonials, but several fronts are experiencing intense, rapidly accelerating combat and recent churn. Endless Shore is the most active region, with 43 ownership events in 24 hours, five in the last two hours, and a mixed 8 Colonial, 1 Warden, 1 neutral distribution. Clahstra is also highly volatile, with 16 events in 24 hours, seven in the last two hours, and a 5–3 Warden advantage. Callahan’s Passage remains a major contested front with eight events, extreme casualty totals, and a 5–5 split. Mooring County has fresh activity and sharply accelerating casualties, enlistments, and ownership events around a 11–1 Colonial split. Speaking Woods is seeing renewed high-intensity fighting and fresh flips with six Warden-held, one Colonial-held, and one neutral base. Godcrofts has substantial accumulated churn—26 events in 24 hours—with a 5–3 Warden split, though its latest recorded event is older than the freshest active fronts.
